title: The main bank's minimum lives in home.main with its own currency (AN3, AL3, AS11): in the main bank's currency it is used, and nothing is asked
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027 in pesos: the peso bank, the main bank, holds 50,000.00 and its minimum, saved in home.main, is 10,000.00 pesos. No pay, no bills, no plan. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 50,000.00 (bank today) - 10,000.00 (the main bank's minimum, from home.main) = 40,000.00

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: The minimum is in the main bank's currency: nothing to ask.
